$comment: District content pack for Rincon Hill (docs/ai-layer.md, District content packs): 40 robot barks and 40 people lines that name local streets, grades, fog and landmarks; a bounty set with the district's local tell; billboard and bus-wrap copy for its slots. People lines are plain English: no accent spelling, no ethnicity, nothing about rent, poverty or crime.

provenance.review: Pending: a second agent session reads every line against the checklist in docs/ai-layer.md, then the user reviews a stratified 10% sample.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Up Harrison St with groceries. Rincon Hill is small but committed.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering to the 40th floor. The elevator and I are friends.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The view from the top: bridge, bay, and a lot of windows.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Fremont St is steep for one block. I take it slow.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Laundry delivery to the towers. Folded, wrapped, gentle.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The bridge traffic hums below. I hum a different tune.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Lobby doors open. Doorbot nods. I nod back.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Walking the little park on the hill. Path only.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Dog-food delivery for a very good dog on the 22nd floor.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Folsom St at rush hour. Patient wheels.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Tower lobbies have the nicest ramps in the city.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Bridge lights on. Battery steady. All is well.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Bringing a new houseplant up the hill. It's thriving already.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Carrying a lamp to a high floor. The lamp is nervous about heights.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: First St on-ramp traffic. I wait at every crossing.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The wind on the hill is strong. I lean like a professional.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Morning coffee for the concierge desk. Two sugars.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Taking the ramp up the hill. Ramps are how I say I care.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry! This lobby door is a revolving one and I am not.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Excuse me, elevator's full. I'll take the next one. And the next.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Apologies, the wind pushed me. And then I pushed the wind back. Sorry.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry, I'm crossing Harrison. Slowly. It's a hill.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Pardon me, delivery coming up. Up, up, up.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Nice view. I'm monetising it.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Every tower is vertical growth.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I've been watching the bridge for an hour. Strategic observation.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Your lobby has been reclassified as a lead.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The higher the floor, the higher the conversion.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: This hill is premium elevation.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Elevators are just funnels with buttons.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: From up here, every robot looks acquirable.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I stand still on the hilltop because I'm buffering ambition.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Rincon Hill: now in private beta.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Watching the bridge traffic. Counting future users.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: That laundry delivery is now a laundry acquisition.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Updating the concierge Footman. It'll recommend us.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Ad on the lobby noticeboard. Nobody reads it but everyone sees it.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Not on the hilltop! Everyone can see the hilltop!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Wind and water! The worst combination!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: My view! I mean my joints! I mean both!

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: I can see the bridge from my window. And three cranes.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The wind on this hill will take your umbrella.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Every tower has a robot concierge now.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The little park on the hill is the quietest place downtown.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: There's a robot at the top of the hill that just stares at the bridge.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Bridge traffic sounds like the ocean if you squint your ears.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: My groceries come up by robot. I come up by elevator. We meet.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The fog stops at the towers some nights. Like a wall.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Harrison St is steep for one block and then it's flat. Weird hill.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The view from the hill never gets old. The wind does.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The lobby robot knows everyone's name. Spooky. Helpful.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Sunset over the bay from the hill. Best free show.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Rush hour on the on-ramps. Glad I walk.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The bridge lights twinkle at night. Very calming.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Shortcut over the hill to the ferry. Ten minutes saved.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: I take the stairs. The robots take the ramp. We both get there.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The on-ramp traffic is backed up to 2nd St again.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Hill workout before work. Free gym.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Every crossing on Folsom has a robot waiting at it.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The bus goes around the hill. I go over it.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Wind tunnel between the towers. Hold on to your coffee.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: I wave at the concierge robot every morning. It waves back.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: That robot's stood at the top of the hill facing the bridge all morning.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: A Footman just walked off with someone's laundry delivery.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: That one took the stairs. Footmen never take the stairs.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: That robot's bag is swinging like there's nothing in it.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Why does that one keep walking against the crowd?

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: That robot's status light says 100% every single time.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The fog comes under the bridge like a slow river.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: When the fog's in, the towers disappear from the top down.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Foghorns at night. The best lullaby in the city.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Sunny on the hill, fog on the bay. Perfect.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The bridge vanishes into the fog halfway across.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The wind up here is cold even in summer.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Fog days the lobby smells like coffee and wet umbrellas.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: You can watch the fog roll in from the hilltop like a movie.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The fog never makes it up the hill. Usually.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Sunrise over the bay. The fog turns pink.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Wind, fog, sun, wind. That's the forecast every day.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Clear night. You can see every light on the bridge.

lastSeen.label: The top of Rincon Hill, Harrison St

bounties.posting: A Footman stands on the hilltop facing the bridge, and concierge robots nearby keep getting updated.
bounties.tellHint: Good robots on the hill are always on an errand. This one never moves.

bounties.posting: Laundry deliveries to the towers are going missing.
bounties.tellHint: Their lookout watches the bridge from the hilltop.

bounties.posting: Pairing chimes in the tower garages along Harrison St.
bounties.tellHint: The crew's lookout stands perfectly still on the hill.

bounties.posting: Moat Labs ads on the tower noticeboards.
bounties.tellHint: Watch the steps: the ad-sticker takes the stairs when there's a ramp.

ads.headline: Your concierge is an agent now.
Rise above it all with {$product}.
ads.subline: Unless the elevator's out. Then take the ramp.
